intro.zh: GPU 從 NVIDIA 出發，一路流過整個生態系：ODM & OEM 把晶片組成伺服器機櫃，CSPs 與 Neoclouds 買下後出租算力，AI Labs 與 AI Natives 用來訓練模型，最後 Enterprise & Industrial 把 AI 用在各行各業。錢則往反方向流回 NVIDIA。
intro.en: GPUs leave NVIDIA and flow through the ecosystem: ODMs & OEMs build them into racks, CSPs and Neoclouds buy them and rent out compute, AI Labs and AI Natives train models, and Enterprise & Industrial put AI to work. Money flows the other way, back to NVIDIA.
